_doc: b-render-d3 hurl retake: up to 9 days of hourly steps under a repainted god storm until >= 4 hurl signs

shots.name: b2-hurl-50
script: G.hold('ui'); G.toastLife(600000); document.getElementById('boot')?.remove(); const t0 = performance.now(); const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const pv = () => F.fx.vis.pv;

let big = null; for (const s of pv().settlements) { const n = [...pv().agents.group].filter((g) => g === s.id).length; if (!big || n > big.n) big = { id: s.id, n, pos: s.pos }; } const sid = big.id; window.__sid = sid; const pos = () => pv().settlements.find((s) => s.id === sid).pos;
await G.cmd({ k: 'set', path: 'disasters.natural', value: 0 }); await G.cmd({ k: 'defiance.set', settlement: sid, value: 0.8 }); await G.cmd({ k: 'pride.set', settlement: sid, value: 0.7 });
const P = pos(); const R0 = pv().ground?.radius ?? 3000; await G.cmd({ k: 'weather.paint', kind: 'thunderstorm', pos: [...P], radius: 900, duration: 6 * 1440, pinned: true });
let hurl = 0, hrs = 0; const cnt = (v) => { const A = pv().agents; let n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < A.count; i++) if (A.group[i] === sid && A.heart && A.heart[i] === v) n++; return n; };

for (hrs = 0; hrs < 24 * 9 && hurl < 4; hrs++) { if (hrs % 48 === 47) await G.cmd({ k: 'weather.paint', kind: 'thunderstorm', pos: [...pos()], radius: 900, duration: 3 * 1440, pinned: true }); await G.step(60); hurl = cnt(5); } await G.frames(1);

const A = pv().agents, R = pv().ground?.radius ?? 3000; const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < A.count; i++) { const s = A.heart ? A.heart[i] : 0; if (s === 5 && !(A.flags[i] & 256)) out.push(i); } let best = -1, bn = -1; for (const i of out) { let n = 0; for (const j of out) { const d = Math.acos(Math.min(1, A.pos[i*3]*A.pos[j*3] + A.pos[i*3+1]*A.pos[j*3+1] + A.pos[i*3+2]*A.pos[j*3+2])) * R; if (d < 25) n++; } if (n > bn) { bn = n; best = i; } } const tgt = best >= 0 ? { kind: 'agent', id: A.id[best] } : { kind: 'settlement', id: sid };
window.__tgt = tgt; G.hold(false); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', target: tgt, dist: 50, tilt: 66, yaw: 30, fov: 50 }); await G.frames(3); G.hold(true);
for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { F.advance(0.3); await G.frames(1); }

return { secs: Math.round((performance.now() - t0) / 1000), hrs, hurl, knot: bn, defiant: pv().settlements.find((s) => s.id === sid)?.defiant, hurlers: F.fx.vis.life.crowds.hurlers.length / 5, arcs: F.fx.defiance.stats, weather: pv().weather.map((w) => w.kind) };

G.hold(false); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', target: window.__tgt, dist: 22, tilt: 72, yaw: 50, fov: 50 }); await G.frames(3); G.hold(true); for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { F.advance(0.3); await G.frames(1); }
